title: block registry recipe
description: How block finds and fetches one blockchain CLI. A recipe is a rule, not a list of versions: a new upstream release needs no change to it.

name.description: The tool's name, which must equal the file name without .toml.

ecosystems.description: The blockchain systems the tool serves. Display and discovery only: block never derives a toolchain from them.

description.description: One plain sentence saying what the tool is, read beside its name.

source.description: How versions and artifacts are discovered and fetched.

type.description: github_release downloads a release asset; http downloads from the upstream's own server.

repo.description: The owner/name GitHub repository whose tags are the version source.

tag_prefix.description: Text before MAJOR.MINOR[.PATCH] in a tag. Defaults to "v"; set "" for bare tags.

asset.description: github_release only. The asset file name template. Without an archive extension it is a single raw executable.

url.description: http only. The HTTPS URL template of the artifact.

strip_components.description: Leading path components to drop when unpacking an archive.

platforms.description: The os/arch pairs the upstream ships. Empty means every platform block supports, or the keys of target.

bin.description: Executables inside the artifact, relative to its root. For a raw executable, the single name to install it under.

os.description: Renames {os} (Go's GOOS) into the upstream's spelling.

arch.description: Renames {arch} (Go's GOARCH) into the upstream's spelling.

target.description: Maps a whole os/arch pair to the upstream's platform string, for {target}.
